purpose: One auditable input record for the deterministic I-band development solver. This record does not authorize an absolute-force prediction for human Q8WZ42-1.

decision.consequence: All public force evaluations and exports are not_evaluated and carry force_pN: null. The numerical laws may be used only for deterministic development geometry and implementation parity audits.

target_applicability.preparation: reference-sequence model; no tissue-specific construct assigned
target_applicability.reason: The model combines rat-psoas material parameters, recombinant-human N2A evidence, and sequence-derived human contours. SD-04 did not approve that combination as an absolute-force predictor.

topology.statement: The four modeled I-band regions share one development-solver force. The unresolved post-N2A interval has no approved contour or force law and is excluded from mechanics.

boltzmann_constant.source_locator: 2019 SI definition of the kelvin; Boltzmann constant exact numerical value

validity.reason: The Boltzmann constant is exact under the SI definition and is not a biological transfer.

temperature.source_locator: Methods; experimental temperature associated with the transferred persistence-length parameterization
temperature.applicability: development reproduction of the source parameterization only
temperature.transfer_rationale: Using the source temperature avoids silently rescaling kT/A; applicability to the target human construct is unapproved.

validity.reason: SD-04 did not approve a temperature or temperature range for target-force evaluation.

persistence_length.source_locator: Discussion, poly-Ig comparison and cited Linke et al. 1998 J Cell Sci 111:1567–1574; entropic WLC fit discussed to about 35 pN
persistence_length.preparation: N-terminal poly-Ig segment in isolated titin/myofibril mechanics
persistence_length.transfer_rationale: Used to generate deterministic folded-tandem straightening geometry; SD-04 did not validate transfer to human Q8WZ42-1.

validity.reason: SD-04 did not approve a target-force validity interval for this transferred parameter.

contour_length.applicability: sequence-derived contour proxy for straightened-but-folded tandem Ig
contour_length.transfer_rationale: Contour is read from the target sequence specification and is not transferred from rat psoas.

validity.reason: The target contour binding is explicit, but SD-04 did not approve its force-law validity range.

persistence_length.transfer_rationale: The source does not establish a tissue-specific full-Q8WZ42-1 N2A construct; SD-04 did not approve quantitative transfer.

validity.reason: SD-04 did not approve a target-force validity interval for this recombinant-fragment transfer.

rigid_folded_length.transfer_rationale: Read from the target titin record so the floor cannot drift from sequence curation.

sensitivity_policy.label: parameter sensitivity range
sensitivity_policy.reason: SD-04 provides no reviewer-approved parameter ranges or covariance policy. Emitting a min/max band would manufacture uncertainty. This is neither a confidence interval nor biological population variance.

precision.reason: No central estimate is displayed while SD-04 is deferred.

output_policy.public_caveat: Regional extension is a deterministic model illustration. Quantitative pN output is withheld because the current parameter transfers, validity range, uncertainty, slack/contact, and unfolding omissions have not been validated for human Q8WZ42-1.
